description: During the 2026-04-23 vision walk the operator discovered all monetization + meta-optimization + marketing-crew member heartbeats had silently been disabled despite the teams being enabled. The prompt-manager UI allows a misleading state because the team-enabled toggle and per-member heartbeat toggle are far apart: team toggle is in the header, member HB toggle is buried inside member > Overview > Schedule. Fix scope: (1) surface each member's HB-enabled state on the member chip / roster in the team dashboard (badge or icon); (2) add a prominent warning banner when team.enabled && activeHeartbeatCount === 0; (3) show active-heartbeat count next to the team toggle (e.g., "Team On (2/5 active)"). Related files per prior exploration: TeamDashboardTab.tsx lines 517-563 and 815-839; MemberScheduleSection.tsx lines 234-248; TeamEditorPanel.tsx lines 434-447.
name: prompt-manager-ui-heartbeat-affordance
title: Prompt-Manager UI Must Surface Member-Heartbeat State On Team Dashboard
